_comment: Report catalog. Each sql is one parameterised SELECT/WITH. @params are bound; {{all_events}} expands to the view; @caller_app is the client the run is for. Every report filters to production events (payload.environment in production|prod) — uat / development / no-env rows are excluded. 'tags' pins a report to specific sourceApp ids. Param types: string | timestamp | date | int64 | bool. Allotment is per client in clients.json.

reports.name: Audit Log Report
reports.description: Every production domain event for one client over a time range, full detail.
reports.sql: SELECT occurred_at, received_at, domain, event_type, action, local_user_id, entity_id, item_count, TO_JSON_STRING(payload) AS payload FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC

reports.name: Event Type Summary
reports.description: Production event and item counts, distinct users, and first/last seen per event type and action.
reports.sql: SELECT event_type, action, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(item_count) AS items, COUNT(DISTINCT local_user_id) AS users, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_seen, MAX(occurred_at) AS last_seen FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY event_type, action ORDER BY events DESC

reports.name: Daily Volume
reports.description: Production events and items per calendar day and domain.
reports.sql: SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS day, domain, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(item_count) AS items FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY day, domain ORDER BY day, domain

reports.name: User Activity
reports.description: Per acting user (production only), keyed by email: event count, domains touched, and first/last activity.
reports.sql: SELECT COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.userEmail'), local_user_id) AS user, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT domain) AS domains, COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) AS entities, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_event, MAX(occurred_at) AS last_event FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY user ORDER BY events DESC

reports.name: Deletions Log
reports.description: Every production DELETE event — what was removed, when, and by which user.
reports.sql: SELECT occurred_at, domain, event_type, local_user_id, entity_id, item_count, TO_JSON_STRING(payload) AS payload FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND action = 'DELETE' AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC

reports.name: Ingest Latency
reports.description: Per day (production): how long after an event occurred it reached Monolith, p50 / p95 / max seconds.
reports.sql: SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS events, APPROX_QUANTILES(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(received_at, occurred_at, SECOND), 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS p50_seconds, APPROX_QUANTILES(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(received_at, occurred_at, SECOND), 100)[OFFSET(95)] AS p95_seconds, MAX(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(received_at, occurred_at, SECOND)) AS max_seconds FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

reports.name: Expense Spend by Category
reports.description: Expenses domain (production): total payload.amount by payload.category and month.
reports.sql: SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE(occurred_at)) AS month, JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.category') AS category, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.amount') AS NUMERIC)) AS total_amount FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND domain = 'expenses' AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY month, category ORDER BY month, total_amount DESC

reports.name: Subscription Costs
reports.description: Subscriptions domain (production): event count and payload.amount by month and action.
reports.sql: SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE(occurred_at)) AS month, action, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) AS subscriptions, SUM(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.amount') AS NUMERIC)) AS total_amount FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND domain = 'subscriptions' AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY month, action ORDER BY month, action

reports.name: Watchlist Churn
reports.description: Watchlist domain (production): adds, updates, and removes per month.
reports.sql: SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE(occurred_at)) AS month, event_type, action, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) AS titles FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND domain = 'watchlist' AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY month, event_type, action ORDER BY month, event_type, action

reports.name: Investment Activity
reports.description: Investments domain (production): event count and payload.amount by month and action.
reports.sql: SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE(occurred_at)) AS month, action, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) AS assets, SUM(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.amount') AS NUMERIC)) AS total_amount FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND domain = 'investments' AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY month, action ORDER BY month, action

reports.name: Report Usage
reports.description: monolith-dashboard (production): runs, rows, users, and last run per report.
reports.sql: SELECT entity_id AS report_id, COUNT(*) AS runs, SUM(item_count) AS rows_total, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.userEmail'), local_user_id)) AS users, MAX(occurred_at) AS last_run FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND event_type = 'REPORT_RUN' AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY report_id ORDER BY runs DESC

reports.name: MCP Usage
reports.description: monolith-dashboard (production): MCP tool calls per day and tool.
reports.sql: SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS day, entity_id AS tool, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND event_type = 'MCP_QUERY' AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY day, tool ORDER BY day, tool

reports.name: Workspace Activity
reports.description: monolith-dashboard (production): daily event count and users by event type.
reports.sql: SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS day, event_type, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT local_user_id) AS users FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY day, event_type ORDER BY day, event_type

reports.name: Account Lifecycle
reports.description: Account domain (production): user account events (e.g. deletions) by day, keyed by email.
reports.sql: SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS day, event_type, action, COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.userEmail'), local_user_id) AS user, COUNT(*) AS events FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND domain = 'account' AND LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY day, event_type, action, user ORDER BY day DESC, events DESC

reports.name: Cross-App Users
reports.description: Users active in more than one app, with the list of apps. Owner only.
reports.sql: SELECT COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.userEmail'), local_user_id) AS user_email, COUNT(DISTINCT source_app) AS app_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT source_app, ', ') AS apps, COUNT(*) AS events, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_event, MAX(occurred_at) AS last_event FROM {{all_events}} WHERE LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY user_email HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT source_app) > 1 ORDER BY app_count DESC, events DESC

reports.name: User Activity Across Apps
reports.description: One row per user email, joined across every app: which apps and domains they touch, event count, first/last. Owner only.
reports.sql: SELECT COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.userEmail'), local_user_id) AS user_email, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT source_app) AS apps, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT source_app, ', ') AS app_list, COUNT(DISTINCT domain) AS domains, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_event, MAX(occurred_at) AS last_event FROM {{all_events}} WHERE LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY user_email ORDER BY events DESC

reports.name: Cross-App Volume
reports.description: Production events per day per app across every integrated app. Owner only.
reports.sql: SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS day, source_app, domain, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(item_count) AS items FROM {{all_events}} WHERE LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.environment')) IN ('production', 'prod') AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY day, source_app, domain ORDER BY day, source_app, domain
